description: This file contains declarations of functions that create ASN.1 object handles related to certificate request messages, certificates, and associated data structures in the context of ASN.1 encoding/decoding for cryptographic protocols. It includes object definitions for various ASN.1 sequences, choices, and primitives used in certificate request and management processes.
